'''''Ctenanthe oppenheimiana''''', the '''giant bamburanta''' or '''never-never plant''', is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] of [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Marantaceae]] and is a native of [[Brazil]].<ref>[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=235166 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families, ''Ctenanthe oppenheimiana'']</ref>  It is an [[evergreen]] [[perennial plant|perennial]]. This plant can grow to more than {{convert|1|m|ft|abbr=on}} tall and broad, with long narrow leaves up to {{convert|40|cm|in|abbr=on}} in length. The leaves are adorned on the secondary veins with dark green bands, which meet and merge in the margins. In between are cream coloured bands. The undersides of the leaves have a red-ish colour.<ref name="AZEGP">{{cite book

La Belgique Horticole 1875: 271, t. 15–17, f. 3, ''Calathea oppenheimiana'' ]</ref> The [[cultivar]] 'Tricolor' is a common ornamental variety, which as a [[houseplant]] in the [[United Kingdom|UK]] has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref name="RHSPF">{{cite web|title=RHS Plantfinder - ''Clenante oppenheimiana'' 'Tricolor'|url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/30926/i-Ctenanthe-oppenheimiana-i-Tricolor/Details|accessdate=12 January 2018}}</ref> (confirmed 2017).<ref>{{cite web|date=July 2017|title=AGM Plants - Ornamental|url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/pdfs/agm-lists/agm-ornamentals.pdf|publisher=Royal Horticultural Society|page=26|accessdate=24 January 2018}}</ref> This cultivar is visually very similar to [[Stromanthe sanguinea|''Stromanthe sanguinea'']] 'Triostar', and the two are often confused. The difference between the two lies in the lack of regular banding on the leaves of the ''Stromanthe'', and the generally more rounded shape of the leaves in ''Ctenanthe''.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Which one is it? Stromanthe Triostar or Ctenanthe Tricolour?|url=https://www.lovethatleaf.co.nz/blogs/plant-care-guides/compare-stromanthe-triostar-calathea-ctenanthe-oppenheimiana-ctenanthe-tricolour-difference|access-date=2021-07-11|website=lovethatleaf|language=en}}</ref>
